[[Treasure Chest]] is a type of [[interactive object]] that will drop [[treasure]] for its user when activated.
Unlike most other [[chest]]s, Treasure Chests do not require [[lockpick]]s or [[key]]s to open.

== Locations ==
* [[Domain of Pain]]
* [[Nightfallen Jahai]]
* [[The Sulfurous Wastes]]
* [[The Hidden City of Ahdashim]]
* [[Jahai Bluffs]]
* [[Mehtani Keys]]

== Notes ==
* Treasure Chests can still be seen even after opening, rezoning, and returning. However, they will be shown as "Empty" when tried to open.
